description: Moonshot's Kimi LLM ships three independent token kinds — pick the one matching how you signed up. Each has its own console, API host, regex, and billing flow.

variants.description: Mainland-China tier. CNY billing, OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.moonshot.cn. Default for users who signed up via WeChat / Alipay.

steps: Sign in with your Moonshot account (WeChat / phone OTP)
Click 创建 API Key (Create API Key)
Name the key (free-form), select scope, confirm
Copy the value — it is only shown once
retrieval.notes: If you also use the Anthropic-compatible endpoint added in 2026 Q1, the same key works at https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic. No extra issuance step.

variants.description: Global tier. USD billing via card / invoice, OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.moonshot.ai. Default for users who signed up via email outside CN.

steps: Sign in (email + OTP, or Google SSO)
Copy the value — it is only shown once
retrieval.notes: Global tier shares regex with CN but routes to a different host. Crossing the keys produces 401 — check the endpoint host before debugging.

variants.description: Flat-rate Coding subscription tier (~ $20/mo). Separate quota pool from CN / global API; key works only against the dev endpoint.

steps: Subscribe to the Coding tier (one-click; flat $20/mo)
Open the Coding dashboard → API Keys panel
Copy the value — it is only shown once
retrieval.notes: Coding-tier keys do NOT work against api.moonshot.cn or api.moonshot.ai. They route exclusively through api.kimi.com/coding/.
